title: Mid Summer Meltdown at Ferndale
description: Men's and Women's triples grass tournament hosted by Level Up Volleyball, relocated this year to Ferndale High School to support their volleyball program. Divisions: Men's & Women's AA/Open, A, and BB; high school girls (grades 10–12); junior high (grades 7–9). Cost: $25 per person (Venmo or cash day-of). Cash prize for AA/Open; apparel prizes for all other divisions. Address is the Ferndale Area Jr/Sr High School (the flyer's '899 Ferndale Ave' is not a geocodable address). Surface inferred as outdoor grass — confirm before publishing.

title: Pitt Bradford Coed Grass 4s (3:1 ratio)
description: Coed grass quads (3:1 ratio) hosted by Level Up Volleyball; proceeds benefit the Pitt-Bradford women's volleyball team. 10 AM start. Divisions: AA/Open, A, BB (may be combined if turnout is low). Cost: $25 per person. Prizes based on turnout. Venue is the Pitt-Bradford Kessel Athletic Complex.

title: Grass Masters Series Event 4: Men's, Women's & HS Girls Doubles
description: Event 4 of Level Up Volleyball's 10-tournament Grass Masters Series (collect points across the series to be named Grass Master). Men's, women's, and high school girls doubles — A10 day (you do not need to be part of A10 to play). Divisions: AA, A, BB (BB is beginner-friendly for the outdoor setting, A intermediate, AA highest). Cost: $25 per player. Per-tournament prizes: AA $100/player, A & BB t-shirts; series cash prizes for top 3 men & women in AA and A. Register by messaging Level Up Volleyball, Ryan Myers, or Dakoda Fickes. Venue: Elderton-Plumcreek Park.

Divisions: AA, A, BB (BB beginner-friendly, A intermediate, AA highest). Cost: $25 per player. title: Coed Summer Doubles (Series #3)
description: Beach (sand) coed doubles tournament hosted by Force Adult Volleyball — part of the Doubles Summer Series (7–8 tournaments) crowning Players of the Year. You don't need the same partner across tournaments; points are tracked individually. Divisions: A, BB, B. Cost: $60. Prizes: apparel. 9:30 AM check-in, 10 AM start.

title: AYOO Ohio Grass Weekend
description: Two-day grass tournament at Volney Rogers Park hosted by Matt Nelson (AYOO, based out of Greensboro, NC). Saturday Jun 13: Coed 4s (one girl minimum). Sunday Jun 14: M/W 3s (small court, block counts as a touch). Both days: 8:45–9:15 AM check-in, 9:30 AM captains' meeting, 9:45 AM first games. Divisions: Open, AA, A, BB (combined if low turnout). Entry: $35 per player, CASH ONLY, paid day-of. All divisions have cash payouts (lower divisions may receive shirts depending on team count). Contact Matt Nelson to sign up.

description: Memorial coed quads tournament hosted by Erie County Grass Volleyball (ECGV) in honor of Jordan Haas, who passed away in May 2026 — all registration proceeds go directly to Jordan's family. Register by messaging the page on Facebook/Instagram or texting 814-218-7918 with player names and preferred division. Payment: Cashapp $booneable, Venmo Daniel-Barker-51, or cash day-of (message to confirm).

title: Coed Fours King & Queen Sand Tournament (June 13)
description: "Social"-style coed fours (king & queen) sand tournament hosted by Scott Phillips. Sign up as a coed pair (one male + one female); you stay with your partner all day while your 3rd and 4th teammates are randomly generated each round of pool play. Individuals accepted as free agents — comment in the event's free-agent section to connect. 12 pairs per division (24 players). Divisions: A (highly competitive / power level), B (competitive / intermediate). Cost: $30 per player; first pairs to pay are listed first — Venmo @scotthphillips. Winners of each division receive a prize. Venue: Robert's Roadside Inn (correct street address per host: 1020 Sharon Rd, Beaver, PA 15009).
